e
THAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (COLONIZATION) (APPEAL AND
REVISION) RULES, 1973
[Gezette of Punjab, Part I,
25th May 1973]
No. 4612‑72/369.‑In exercise of the
powers conferred on him by clause (xix) of subsection (1) of section 50 of the
Thal Development Act, 1949, (W. Punjab Act XV of 1949) and !n supersession of
previous notification No. L & F‑5(E)/19‑59, dated the 22nd July
1960, the Governor of the Punjab is pleased to make the following rules:‑
1. (1) These rules may be called the Thal Development
Authority .(Colonization) (Appeal and Revision) Rules, 1973.
(2) They shall come into force
at once.
2. In these rules, unless the context otherwise
requires, the following expressions shall have the meanings hereby respectively
assigned to them, that is to say:‑
(a) "Authority" means
Thal Development Authority created under section 3 of the Thal Development Act,
1949.
(b) "Board of
Revenue" means the Board of Revenue established under the West Pakistan
Board of Revenue Act, 1957;
(c) "Delegatee" means
any officer of the Provincial Government who before the coming into force of
these rules has been authorised by the Administrator Thal Development, to
exercise any powers and perform any duties in connection with the colonizatian
of lands vesting in the Administ rator ; and
(d) "Administrator Thal Development" means
an officer appointed as such by the Provincial Government under section 81 of
the Thal development Act, 1949, after the dissolution of the Authority.
3. Any tenant to whom land has been allotted by the
Authority or by he Administrator, Thal Development, in accordance with any
statement of conditions Issued by Authority under subsection (2) of section 30
of the Thal Development Act, 1949, and any person who has acquired proprietary
sights in the land so allotted him, may if aggrieved by any order passed by the
Authority or by the Administrator, Thal Development or by a delegates or an
officer of the Authority file an appeal in accordance with these Rules.
4. An appeal shall lie from an original or appellate
order‑
(a) to the Collector when the order is made by an
officer exercising the powers of Assistant Collector of either grade or
Secretary, Thal Development Authority or Estate Officer or Land Control Officer
or Land Acquisition Officer;
(b) to the Commissioner when the order is made by the
Collector or Colonization Officer, Thal Project Colony;
(c) to the Board of Revenue only on a point of Law
when the order is made by the Administrator or the Commissioner either as a
delegatee of otherwise or Chairman. Thal Development Authority.
(i) when an original order is confirmed on appeal by
the Collector, the order made by the Commissioner on further appeal if any, to
him shall be final.
5. The period of limitation for
an appeal under these rules shall runt from the date of the order appealed
against and shall be‑
(a) thirty days when the appeal
lies to the Collector ;
(b) sixty days when the appeal
lies to the Commissioner; and
(c) ninety days when the appeal
lies to the Board of Revenue.
6. The Board of Revenue, may at any time, call for
the record of any case pending before, or, disposed of by the Administrator,
Thal Development,, or by any other revenue officer subordinate to it and pass
such orders as it may deem fit;
Provided that‑--
No order under this rule shall be passed reversing or
modifying any, proceedings or order affecting any person without giving such
person an~ opportunity of being heard.
7. Subject to the provisions of
these rules. the procedure provided in the West Pakistan Land Revenue Act,
1967, and the Rules made thereunder shall, so far as may be followed in the
proceedings under these rules.
